d: In the Bahamas, two superfans face relentless insects and aggressive sharks during hurricane season which probes at their determination to hold on.
A prowling black panther, tree sap poisonous to the touch, and a week of freezing rain lead a pair of survivalists right up to the breaking point.
Ten survivalists are thrown into the bleak Colombian savanna. Extreme heat threatens the teams, with one pair struggling to make it to a water source.
Two survivalists tackle Subic Bay, an area prone to natural disasters. Soon, they contend with harsh rainstorms and territorial monkeys.
Bear drops from a bi-plane into the Chihuahuan Desert in West Texas, where he withstands extreme heat, navigates deep gorges and dodges deadly diamondbacks.
International survivalists work in duos across 40 days of wilderness, living to honour their countries and claim a monetary reward.
Bear Grylls shows how to survive the big island of Hawaii, home to Kilauea, the world's most active volcano and one of the toughest places on Earth.
Dawid traverses across Udupi to distribute motorbikes in Delhi. He negotiates congested traffic and encounters a stationary Hindustan Ambassador beside the highway.

t: Into the Jungle with Ed Stafford
d: Ed's unique jungle expedition concludes with the dads and kids going to Five Blues Lake and navigating an ancient cave complex.
Forced to battle the elements, Bear Grylls and Michael B. Jordan must contend with copious amounts of rain and wind and get creative about finding warmth for the evening's dinner.
Bear is in Scotland off the coast around Cape Wrath. He fashions a wetsuit from a dead seal and has a close call with a rockfall before making camp in an old, upturned boat.
The host gives a lesson on how to fish reefs, with species like bonefish and milkfish caught for fun, and he attempts to swim with sailfish.
Ed participates in the annual rite of passage festival Naadam to wrestle an enormous heir of Genghis Khan in order to prove his masculinity.
After becoming stranded in Northern Africa, Bear shows his resourcefulness by devising a jugaad to find water, catching an octopus, eating a bug burger and building a resting place.
Darrell's student embraces a gothic-themed graduation ceremony. Meanwhile, Kenny quietly explores an undercover role, leading to an unexpected career prospect.
Ash Dykes and his team set out to navigate the Coppename River for three days before trekking through the rainforest to discover its unexplored source.
Shipwrecked on an island in the South China Sea, castaways Grady and Josh use their initiative to survive and try to get drinking water from garbage on the beach.
A survival expert tries to survive the sweltering, crocodile-infested Northern Territory.

Bear is in the Caucasus Mountains driving a snowmobile out the back of a hovering helicopter. Later, he ziplines across a river and trudges swampy wetlands.
Accompanied by old friend and guide Binod, Levison tracks through the mountains from eastern Nepal into the final country of his journey, Bhutan.
